compiled_state.title: RED: tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh (8 cases, PATH-stubbed)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(RED test task — DD ownership lies with task-2 GREEN implementation. This task pins the contract via 8 test cases that collectively cover dd-1 through dd-5 by behavioral assertion.)

## Implementation Notes
Mirror PATH-stubbing pattern from tests/scripts/test-verify-aws-account.sh. Use tests/lib/assert.sh helpers. Set -euo pipefail.

### Stubs
- Stub `aws` on PATH: deterministic responses based on subcommand + args; log every invocation to a counter/log file.
- Stub `read-config` (or DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD): returns canned config values for review_telemetry.* keys.
- Tmp dso-config.conf for write-back tests.

### 8 test cases (function names — used as RED marker reference)
1. `t_happy_path_creates_all_resources` — fresh state; exit 0; stub log shows create-bucket + put-public-access-block + put-bucket-encryption + put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration + put-bucket-policy each exactly once.
2. `t_rerun_is_no_op` — seeded state; counter increments on put-bucket-*/create-bucket; second run counter == 0; exit 0.
3. `t_missing_iam_aborts_before_create` — iam list-attached-user-policies omits required perm; exit 5; zero create-bucket calls; stderr names missing perm.
4. `t_public_access_block_set_before_policy` — fresh state; assert log ordering (put-public-access-block precedes put-bucket-policy by line number).
5. `t_policy_references_lambda_role_arn` — config returns lambda_role_arn=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/test-lambda-role; capture --policy arg passed to put-bucket-policy; JSON contains exact ARN as Allow Principal + Deny on non-matching principals for s3:PutObject.
6. `t_config_write_preserves_existing_keys` — seed conf with unrelated.key=value; run; assert unrelated.key=value remains + review_telemetry.bucket_name=<created> appended.
7. `t_config_write_rewrites_existing_bucket_name_key` — seed conf with review_telemetry.bucket_name=stale-bucket; run; assert EXACTLY ONE review_telemetry.bucket_name= line + value is new (not stale).
8. `t_region_pinned_to_us_east_1` — assert every captured s3api call has `--region us-east-1` OR AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 in env.

### .test-index RED marker (test-file-side, space before bracket)
```
plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh: tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh [t_happy_path_creates_all_resources]
```

chmod +x. ShellCheck-clean.

## TDD Test Spec (Given/When/Then)
Given a PATH-stubbed environment where `aws` and `read-config` are replaced by deterministic shims AND plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh does not yet exist; When the test runner invokes each of the 8 named test functions; Then every test case fails with missing-script or behavior-mismatch error (exit non-zero), AND `.test-index` RED entry allows the test gate to treat failures as expected pre-impl.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists, executable, set -euo pipefail
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh && head -5 tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh | grep -q 'set -euo pipefail'
- [ ] All 8 test functions defined
  Verify: for fn in t_happy_path_creates_all_resources t_rerun_is_no_op t_missing_iam_aborts_before_create t_public_access_block_set_before_policy t_policy_references_lambda_role_arn t_config_write_preserves_existing_keys t_config_write_rewrites_existing_bucket_name_key t_region_pinned_to_us_east_1; do grep -qE "^${fn}\(\)|^function ${fn}" tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh || { echo "MISSING: $fn"; exit 1; }; done
- [ ] Test does NOT call real aws (uses PATH-stubbed shim)
  Verify: grep -qE 'DSO_AWS_CMD|PATH=.*\$mock_bin' tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh
- [ ] Test does NOT contact real AWS endpoints
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'amazonaws\.com' tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh
- [ ] ShellCheck passes
  Verify: shellcheck tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker for new test
  Verify: grep -qE 'aws-setup-bucket\.sh.*test-aws-setup-bucket\.sh \[' .test-index
- [ ] Pre-impl run fails RED
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -ne 0

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Escalation Policy
Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference.
